name: KiTS 2023
description: Kidney and Kidney Tumor Segmentation Challenge (KiTS) 2023 offers a platform for researchers to compare their solutions to segmentation from 3D CT. In this work, we describe our submission to the challenge using automated segmentation of Auto3DSeg available in MONAI. Our solution achieves the average dice of 0.835 and surface dice of 0.723, which ranks first and wins the KiTS 2023 challenge.
reputation: KiTS is a prominent medical image segmentation challenge and a common benchmark for kidney and tumor CT segmentation.
notes: Challenge benchmark with strong competition but limited dataset size. Performance depends on preprocessing, ensembling, and post-processing; not an LLM benchmark.
